abstract: Spaceship hosting is very cheap and fast for US visitors, with 99.992% uptime in a 90-day test. Backups are priced separately, there is no phone support, and renewals are 1.45 to 1.77 times the first year.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes for small sites near the US. SimonHosting measured 99.992% uptime over 90 days and a 242 ms time to first byte.

mainEntity.name: How much does Spaceship hosting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Essential is $19.88 for the first year and $28.88 a year at renewal. Pro is $28.88 then $48.88. Supreme is $38.88 then $68.88.

mainEntity.name: Is there a Spaceship promo code?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its sale page lists COM67 for a .com at $3.60, NET19 for .net and IO85 for .io, for new registrations.

mainEntity.name: Does Spaceship have a free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every shared plan starts with a 30-day free trial.
SimonHosting measured a 242 ms time to first byte and a 1.4 second Largest Contentful Paint. Prehost's real-user median is 1.1 seconds.

mainEntity.name: Does Spaceship include email and backups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Essential lists 5 free mailboxes per domain, and Pro and Supreme list 25 free mailboxes for one year. AutoBackup is listed as a separate feature, with TechRadar reporting backups from $11.76 for 5 GB on a two-year plan.

mainEntity.name: Is Spaceship the same as Namecheap?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, but DevProblems says it is built on Namecheap's foundation, and TechRadar found near-identical server performance.

mainEntity.name: Does Spaceship have an AI website builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It lists an AI website builder and WordPress AI tools on all plans, plus MCP access for AI agents.
It lists a 99.99% guarantee. SimonHosting measured 99.992% and Scribeage 100%.

mainEntity.name: Does Spaceship have a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: We did not find one on the page we read. It offers a 30-day free trial.
People who need phone support, want backups included, or want a long-established host.
